title: Film Screening
text: Well, the battle with Takt is over. Next up is dealing with my Father and the others. Some time has passed, and they’ve returned from Cal Mira Island and made it back to the castle. Both Ren and Itsuki are participating in the “Wave” of a neighboring country under the kingdom’s orders.

After that, they’ll return to work on restoring the lost trust… Apparently, there’s a campaign led by the Queen to spread rumors that they deliberately damaged their reputation in order to destroy the “Three Heroes Church,” as it’s known to the public. There was a plan along these lines in the original world as well, but because Ren, Itsuki, and I broke the seal on the Spirit Tortoise sooner than expected, the restoration of trust was significantly delayed. Well, thanks to advice from Fleon-chan and the others, both Ren and Itsuki were able to avoid taking any actions that would break the seals on the Spirit Tortoise or the Phoenix.
“It’s your fathers-in-law!”
“Ah, Motoyasu… I hear you left the island first, entrusting everything to your Filolial. What on earth have you been up to?”
Just then, a shadow fluttered down from the sky with a flapping sound.
“Gaelion’s here!”
My rival, in his young dragon form, landed with only his wings enlarged. By the way, he’s already discarded his Takt Dragon body.
“What’s that thing?”
My Father is pointing at my rival.
“Hmm…”
“Motoyasu-sama!”
Filo-tan glared at my rival, and Yuki-chan jumped into my arms.
“Please be careful! It’s a dragon!”
“That’s right. This one is a dangerous dragon! It’s true that I’d like to take him down immediately, if possible.”

However, even though I’m not exactly fond of this guy, he’s done me many favors. He ended up saving countless of Filolial-sama’s eggs, and at my kind Father’s command, he cleaned up the mess I’d made. So, partly as a reward for this achievement, I brought him here via the portal.
“First, let me introduce myself. I am Gaelion, the Dragon Emperor who stored my memories within the Spear of the Spear Hero and hitched a ride on the loop. It’s a pleasure to make your acquaintance.”
“…Are you part of that gang of weirdos like Motoyasu?”
“That’s hurtful. Gaelion is merely here at the request of Naofumi from another world.”
“Oh, I see…”
“Unlike the Spear Hero, who’s a bit vague on the details, I can answer all sorts of questions about the future.”
“That’d be a big help. You never know what this guy’s going to pull. Wait—is Motoyasu looping with a dragon?”
“He’s a detestable parasite, you know.”
“Say what you will—it’s Gaelion’s job, after all.”
Hmph… Just because you’ve solved a few problems doesn’t mean you should get too cocky. Someday, I’ll make sure you can’t use your eyes to gain the upper hand!
“It’s not exactly a proposal to start things off, but…”
With a flutter, Rival stood before my Father and held out a hand. Then, the color of the gem attached to my Father’s armor changed.
“…What did you do?”
“I made it easier to control the rage. While I was at it, I transferred the consciousness of Gaelion’s parent—who resides within the Core Stone—over here.”
“Hmm… You’re certainly under a protective blessing.”
“It’s a token of goodwill to earn your trust. You should be willing to listen to me for a bit.”
“…Alright. I’ll verify whether this is true later… Wait, Gaelion’s parent residing in the Core Stone?”

“That’s right. Gaelion is the child of the dragon zombie that Naofumi and the others defeated in its previous life… though even in the first world known to the Spear Hero, Gaelion is already dead. It’s simply that Gaelion survived in a possible world that looped.”
My father looks at my rival with a puzzled expression.
“So, are you saying that a survivor from the world where Motoyasu looped imbued his consciousness into the spear and hitched a ride?”
“That’s right. The first Naofumi Gaelion knew was the one saved from a false accusation by the Spear Hero.”
My Father sighed wearily at his Rival’s reply.
“What’s this dragon doing here now, anyway?”
“Gaelion is assisting the Spear Hero at the request of Naofumi from another loop.”
“But Motoyasu seems to be reluctant, doesn’t he?”
“It’s fine—he’s built up a track record that makes it impossible to refuse outright.”
“Father! Be careful! This guy is a dragon out to take your virginity!”
I’m going to take preemptive action here. Big Sister and her older sister need to take Father’s virginity and her virginity as soon as possible!
“I’m not after it anymore.”
My rival is waving her hand as if she’s completely unfazed. What’s more, she’s cheerfully waving at Big Sister’s older sister, too.
“Oh my—?”
“Well, if Naofumi’s interested, she’ll probably let him have a go after Raph. Gaelion has become a female who can exercise self-control.”
Big Sister looks displeased, too. Go ahead and let everyone hate you then.
“Why would it turn out that way?”
Exactly! Sure, I ended up losing to my Rival because of Father’s selfless devotion to me, but there isn’t even a shred of room for you here!
“Raphtalia doesn’t even have any intention of doing something like that in the first place. Her goal is to put an end to the turmoil. What good would it do to waste her time on such nonsense?”
My sister looks heartbroken by Father’s response. It’s true that Father has been misunderstanding her lately.
“Raph? I don’t have a clue what that dragon’s saying, Kou.”
“It’s okay if you don’t understand, Kou… If possible, please don’t bring it up.”
“Oh my—I’m rooting for you too, Big Sister! Raphtalia-chan!”
“Sadeena, please don’t jump on the bandwagon!”
“Too bad, Big Sister. I think Naofumi-chan is wonderful, you know?”
It seems my Father and Big Sister’s older sister are already in the middle of a drinking contest. Unfortunately, since I can’t afford to get completely drunk, I declined to join them at the tavern.
“Oh my, really? I’m rooting for Raph, you know.”
“Please stop saying things like that in all seriousness…”
My older sister says this with a somewhat sullen air about her. That’s true. I understand that cheering for a Rival would be counterproductive.
“Anyway, there sure are more noisy people around now… Are you going to look after Motoyasu?”
“That’s what I’ve been asked to do, so I’ll do my best to lighten Naofumi’s load.”
“I see. That’ll be a big help. Do your best to keep this guy from doing anything weird.”
“I’ll try my best, but there are limits, so there will probably be times when I have to leave it up to you.”
“Rival! Don’t even think I’m going to listen to anything you have to say anymore.”
“Is it okay to say something like that?”
As he says this, Rival steers my gaze toward Filo-tan, who’s glaring at him as if to intimidate him. Ugh… I know exactly what he’s getting at. He’s provoking me because he knows I can’t defy him!
“So you’re saying Motoyasu obeys Filo because he’s afraid of her?”
“Well, yeah. Do you want to know?”
“Just hearing the gist of it doesn’t really explain everything…”
You bastard, Rival! Do you really intend to brazenly tell my Father about that memory?!
“To put it simply, the Spear Hero has a hard time with sick women.”
“Those guys are pigs!”

All the guys in my memories are pigs, aren’t they? They’re all just a bunch of self-centered jerks who tried to manipulate me however they pleased! The moment something didn’t go their way, they’d immediately throw a tantrum, get upset, and start whining—and to top it all off, they’d even try to kill me. In fact, they’re no different from Crimson Swine—just a bunch of pigs trying to control me however they please!
“Someone as perceptive as you, Ofumi, should be figuring this out by now.”
“You guys sure do talk as if you really know me… Come to think of it, Motoyasu said he came to this world after being stabbed to death by a woman he was cheating on.”
My father says this while deep in thought. Then he looked at Filo-tan.
“Hmm… The most likely explanation is that Filo went through some kind of yandere transformation in one of the loops.”
Eeeeeek! That memory—!

Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Filo-tan, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father -san, Father!
“You got it exactly right! The timing was just awful.”
“Hmm? What’s up with Filo?”
“Depending on the timing, you could turn into a yandere.”
“What’s a yandere?”
Filo-tan tilts her little head as if she has no idea what that means.
“Depending on the loop, Filo can also become a Filolial named Sakura—a laid-back type. According to Naofumi from the first world, she’s an upgraded version.”
“How pitiful, Filo…”
“Boo!”
“Father! You shouldn’t compare Filo-tan and Sakura-chan! Sakura-chan is certainly laid-back, but I like Filo-tan.”
It’s not that I’m dismissing Sakura-chan. It’s just that I love Filo-tan—there’s nothing I can do about that.
“Hmm?”
“Well… the folks who knew the first Naofumi—the one the Spear Hero knew—said that the Naofumi the Spear Hero saved was also an upgraded version.”
“You, you…”
My father is bulging with veins as he shows his anger. But at the same time, he’s petting Filo-tan’s head. He probably understands how Filo-tan feels.
“My Father is my Father. There’s no need to compare… Still, I do feel bad for my Father, who sacrificed himself to a Rival for my sake.”
“Nooo!”
Don’t get embarrassed!
“Oh my—”
Even the Big Sister of the woman who, as far as I know, was the first to take my Father’s virginity is blushing!
“What’s that supposed to mean! Are you trying to say I had some kind of relationship with this guy!?”
“It’s got nothing to do with the Naofumi of now, so don’t worry about it. It’s just a possibility within the loop.”
“There’s absolutely no way that happened, so give it up!”
My father made a face that clearly showed how much he hated that idea.
“Well, I won’t deny that Naofumi was partly to blame for that incident. Naofumi, you shouldn’t act with such a strong focus on making money. You can’t go wrong there—”
“Shut up. I’m just earning money to get what I need… Wait… I’ve pretty much figured out what you did.”

“By the way, as for the timing… that loop was a little different, so I’m not sure if it actually happened, but it was around the time I experienced the Wave and met the Spear Hero before Filo started speaking human language.”
“That timing, huh… It’s annoying that I can’t exactly say it’s impossible…”
Father nodded as if he fully understood the situation.
“Well, fine. So I get that you’ve introduced yourself and know your role. Did you come here to discuss future plans, just like Motoyasu?”

“I’m not entirely sure how much the Spear Hero has told you, but I’ll definitely help out fully. But before that, I’d like Naofumi and the others to take a look at the strategy the Spear Hero and Gaelion used.”
Rival made several video crystals float up, their surfaces glistening.
“It’s a screening at the castle!”
“What on earth is going on here?”
“How should I know…”

It seems Rival is holding a broadcast using video crystals, billed as a “screening at the castle.” My Finacée has been invited as well. The Queen and the Immortal are reportedly absent due to personal matters. My Big Sisters are also sitting in chairs with Father, watching the show. Filo-tan doesn’t know what’s going on, but she’s sitting there with her eyebrows furrowed at Rival.
“Here’s some popcorn.”
“Are you giving it to me? Yay!”

Popcorn is the only thing that works at a time like this. By the way, the popcorn I prepared isn’t just any popcorn. It’s caramel-flavored! I handed Filo-tan the popcorn I’d cooked with my spear. Then, since Yuki-chan said she wanted to sit next to me, I sat down next to her.
“Please, have some, Yuki-chan.”
“Thank you so much!”
Kou is sitting politely next to his Big Sister.
“Well, it’s a surprise—you’ll have to wait and see.”
With a “zzz…” sound, the lights in the room went out, and an image began to project onto the wall. With a “Roar!” Rival stuck his head out of a hole like a lion and roared.
“The Nano Project! Nano!”
That voice had been recorded. A video with audio—they really went all out for no reason.
The Father begins watching the video with an exasperated look on his face. It starts with a scene of Takt and the others aboard a boat heading to Seven Island, gazing out at the island.
“It’s so relaxing to come here!”
That’s the vibe as they look out at the island while surrounded by a bunch of pigs.
“Oink-oink!”
“Oink.”
I have absolutely no idea what they’re saying. They’re probably just spouting some filth, as usual.
